title: Transient-Safe Platooning via Dynamic Headway
summary: Managing autonomous vehicle platoons requires a delicate balance between string stability and rigorous safety. This challenge is intensified by aggressive transients, such as highway merging. Although Constant Time Headway (CTH) spacing is the industry standard for Cooperative Adaptive Cruise Control, it lacks formal safety guarantees during significant velocity deviations. This letter proposes a computationally efficient control framework that considers a linear time-invariant model for the dynamics of each vehicle, while ensuring formal transient safety and stability.
